title: Not too cooling, not too fuffy.
text:
Not too cooling, not too fuffy.. After scouring the internet for a fluffy but cool mattress topper, I found this one and was wooed by the words "cooling" and "bamboo" and the price was right. I even purchased a new sheet set with a low thread count so I could feel the difference.
First, the padding is that's supposed to be fluffy is somewhat flat. It's a minor improvement to the posturepedic mattress.
And Second, it's not cooling. I've been sweating the same as I was before. Maybe it's a pregnancy thing, but I was hoping the "bamboo" would pull through for me. It doesn't even feel like bamboo to the touch, it's more of a soft flannel-like feel.
Coming out of the box I felt it and it did, in fact, feel a little cool when pressing down, which made me excited to sleep on it. Too bad it didn't make any actual difference.
